source_text: Contempserunt mortem, pericula, contumelias dum voluntati Dei deserviunt. Gloria Dei sermoni. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They despised death, dangers, insults while they served God’s will. Glory to God’s word. Amen.
pass_b_english: They despised death, danger, and insult while serving God’s will in prophecy. Glory to the Word. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
